text:
mika: FYI planning rollforward to runtime 2.20 at 02:00 UTC. Includes KV-pointer fix + kernel reorder. Need quick pin decision for embed-* and longseq-quant.

julian: Do we require SDK 3.6.0 for the new routing headers? If yes, call it out and include fallback.

priya: Canary (ap-east) shows p95 +7% for llama3q-quant with kv on. No errors, but warmup longer on tiny batches.

julian: Proposal: soft-pin embed-* -> 2.19 for 4h after roll; allow text-gen and safety models to move to 2.20.

ops-oncall: Set deadman revert at 05:00 UTC. Auto-revert if 5xx > 1.5% OR p95 increase > 25% sustained 8m.

deploybot: Automated: snapshotting pinlist at 01:30 UTC. Preview diff:
```
- runtime_pin: 2.19 -> models: [assistant-core/*]
+ runtime_pin: 2.20 -> models: [fast-sampler/*]
+ soft_pin: embed-* -> runtime:2.19 until 06:00 UTC
```

mika: Decision: apply soft_pin for embed-* only. Action items:
- priya: publish canary traces + minimal repro by 01:10.
- julian: update release notes with SDK 3.6.0 fallback snippet by 01:20.
- deploybot: apply soft_pin at 01:30 and publish pin diff to /releases/2.20/pins.
- ops-oncall: enable deadman revert at 05:00 and page leads if triggered.

priya: Repro sample: `summarize(large_doc, chunk_size=2048)` shows first-chunk delay. I'll attach flame graphs to the PR.

julian: Fallback snippet for notes:
```
client:
  runtime_preference: ["2.20","2.19"]  # SDK 3.6.0 will try 2.20 then fallback
```

ops-oncall: Revert rule set. If triggered, deploybot will automatically apply previous pinlist and post to #release-ops, then page release leads.

deploybot: Confirmed: soft_pin applied at 01:30 UTC. Pin diff published. Rollforward scheduled 02:00 UTC.

mika: Please report any correctness regressions in this thread and tag me. We'll hold any additional unpins until 08:00 UTC.

priya: Follow-up: traced a small hotspot in kv_refresh() with batch_size=1. Filing follow-up ticket but not blocking the roll.

julian: I'll push SDK changelog + quick rollback snippet once CI passes.

deploybot: Automated: rollforward started 02:00 UTC. Will post success/failure update.
